[angshu] I don't think so.
The post you're referring to is about the Watch Ultra 2, not the Watch 9. It also involves trading, and some of the specific codes mentioned are only applicable to the Ultra variant.
The only relevant part is that it mentions getting the UNI2 code for O Week, which saves you an additional A$50 and could bring the price of this watch down to A$350.
The caveat is that obtaining the code can take up to 48 hours. Given the time constraint for this post, that wasn't a viable option, which is why I haven't included it.
